newsitem.title: USA: Ekco to take Q4 charge of $5.1 million.
newsitem.headline: Ekco to take Q4 charge of $5.1 million.

text.p: Ekco Group Inc said it will take a pre-tax, fourth-quarter charge of about $5.1 million to consolidate its Easthampton, Massachusetts-based cleaning products plant into its existing manufacturing plant in Hamilton, Ohio.

The charge is related to severance costs and the writedown of assets, the company said. The company also said it expects additional operating expenses associated with the consolidation, but it did not quantify them.
The company said it estimates its annualized pre-tax savings from the consolidation will be about $2.3 million.

Ekco said the consolidation -- as well as the building of a new on-site distribution plant -- will add 225 jobs in Hamilton, Ohio. The company did not specify how many jobs would be lost in Easthampton, Mass.
Ekco officials were not immediately available to comment.
The company makes household items such as bakeware, kitchenware and plastic storage products.
